testCase.name: [dev] S15 Time to a settled list: search and re-sort on 120 patients per context

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S15 「到列表稳定的时间：每个模式 120 个病人上的搜索和重新排序」 Time to a settled list: search and re-sort on 120 patients per context

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 2；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 3；TFA-92581 AC 6）
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 6）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given 120 Hospital patients and 120 Nursing Home residents (S14 generator, larger count)

When Search a single name, clear, then switch sort room → name → status, in each context

Then Each action ends in a settled list; the time from the last keystroke or sort change to the settled list is recorded per action

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：No UAT or ticket time target (Q11): timings are reported as data for Daniela, not judged. Correctness of the settled list is judged by S12–S14

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PERF · 性能计时；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（not-testable）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev，lane datasets（datasets/results.json，截图不附）。

测试方法：PERF · 性能计时；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev/datasets。
